text:
Done. I've completed an independent review and written the verdict to REVIEW.md.

**What I verified:**
- **API implementation**: Sign-in, submit, approve, list, sign-out endpoints all wired correctly with express-session
- **Data validation**: Categories and dates validated at boundaries; amount field has no validation
- **Authorization**: Session checks present; manager-only checks present; but any manager can approve any claim (overpermissive)
- **Concurrency**: Found a race condition in ID generation that will cause data loss
- **UI**: The public/index.html is empty—no forms, no claim display, no actual user interface exists
- **Tests**: One passing test covering only the happy path; no error or authorization test coverage
- **Configuration**: Session cookie security flag won't work in development

**Verdict:** Not ready for production. The tool has no UI, will lose data under concurrent load, and lacks proper manager authorization checks. Finance cannot use this to replace the spreadsheet Monday.
